6. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided historical context of "The Guernsey Literary and Potato Peel Pie Society":
   - Set on the island of Guernsey during WWII, occupied by German forces from 1940 to 1945.
   - Discussed the hardships faced by islanders during the occupation, including food shortages and labor camps.
7. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Mary Ann Shaffer was inspired to write the novel after visiting Guernsey in 1980 and learning about the islanders' resilience and a book club formed during the occupation.
8. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The novel is set in 1946 and follows Juliet Ashton, a writer who connects with the islanders through letters.
9. [PREFERENCE] The user is looking forward to reading "The Guernsey Literary and Potato Peel Pie Society."
10. [EVENT] The user is thinking about starting a book club with friends.
11. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided tips for starting a book club:
    - Define the purpose and scope of the club.
    - Choose a format (in-person, online, frequency).
    - Select a core group of members (5-10).
    - Pick a name and create an identity.
    - Decide on a book selection process.
    - Establish a discussion format.
    - Set expectations for participation.
    - Plan for food and drink.
    - Create a schedule.
    - Be flexible and open-minded.
